subject: Urgent: production 429 spike — project quota mapping gap
messages:
From: Todd Williams <todd.williams@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

Hi Karthik,

We're seeing sustained 429 spikes and timeouts from Redwood (tokens failing) across our nightly billing pipeline starting ~08:50 PT. Jobs that normally finish in 15m are retrying and failing; we're hitting billing SLA windows. This started right after our project migration to the "pro-tiering" org mapping yesterday. Our SRE team sees a burst of requests getting 429s and then exponential retries.

Can you confirm whether NovaHealth's org->project limits were migrated correctly? If this is a quota/tiering misconfiguration on your side we need an immediate mitigation plan — and we'll likely need credits for failed runs.

Attached: ops-alerts-screenshots (we can share logs if helpful).

—Todd
Head of Platform — NovaHealth

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

Thanks Todd — saw this come through from monitoring.

Team, looping you in for triage. Initial glance at our routing logs shows NovaHealth traffic was mapped to a newly created project alias during yesterday's org-tiering cutover; that alias retained the lower per-project token rate (100 TPS burst) instead of the intended pro tier (1k TPS). The mismatch would explain the 429 front-load and retry amplification.

Immediate asks: aditya, can infra apply a temporary quota override to the project (to match pro-tier) and confirm cache/prefix routing is flushed? lauren, can CS join the bridge and coordinate messaging with NovaHealth? marissa, might need a ran-up exec notice — this could touch renewal conversations.

I'll start a dedicated ticket and capture logs.

—Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

On Mon, Jul 12, 2027 at 09:28 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Immediate asks: aditya, can infra apply a temporary quota override to the project (to match pro-tier) and confirm cache/prefix routing is flushed?

We're on it. Root cause confirmed: during the org migration the project alias namespace was created without inheriting the org-level tier mapping. The mapping table still points the alias to the base tier. I will: 
- apply a temporary override (pro-tier limits) to NovaHealth's project (15 min window)
- flush request routing cache and propagate mapping to edge (expect 4–6m to converge)
- add a short-lived rate-limit grace policy to reduce client retry penalty while cache warms

I'll post the override screenshots once live and create SUP-4219 for the permanent fix.

Attachments: pm-logs-429-20270712.txt

—Aditya
Prod Infra — Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Todd Williams <todd.williams@novahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

Todd — thanks for the heads up and the screenshots. We're on a bridge with Infra; preliminary mitigation is in flight (quota override + cache flush).

Actionable next steps for NovaHealth:
- Hold scheduled billing jobs for 30 minutes to avoid compounding retries.
- If you can, set an exponential backoff on the billing worker to avoid retry storms.

We'll share a short note when we confirm traffic normalization. Apologies for the disruption — we'll follow with a postmortem and ask on credits once we have the full impact.

—Lauren
Sr. Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Todd Williams <todd.williams@novahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

Update: Aditya applied the temporary override at 10:18 PT and we flushed the mapping cache. Edge propagation completed ~10:24 PT. I'm attaching the override confirmation and a short dump of the 429 counters — you can see the tail fall off after propagation.

Attachments: quota-override-screenshot.png

Marissa — we should prepare a brief for their execs; Evelyn can you own the credits ask (estimate failed runs and $ exposure)? I'll draft a postmortem and timeline for a permanent mapping fix (SUP-4219).

Todd — can you confirm whether your billing window recovered? If you still see timeouts we'll keep the override while we complete the fix.

—Karthik

From: Todd Williams <todd.williams@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 429s + timeouts hitting billing pipeline — urgent

Thanks — fyi our pipelines tested and the retry noise has dropped to baseline after 10:30. Billing jobs completed in the next window with expected runtimes.

Please proceed with the postmortem and let us know your recommendation on credits; we'll need a short executive note for our procurement team. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Todd
